name: AutoCodeBench
intro: AutoCodeBench是一个大规模代码生成基准，包含3920个问题，均匀分布在20种编程语言中。它旨在评估大型语言模型在具有挑战性、多样化和实用性的多语言任务上的表现。该基准利用名为AutoCodeGen的自动化方法生成，通过LLM与多语言沙箱的交互来创建高质量的测试用例，无需人工标注。
build_method: Stack-Edu种子, LLM-沙箱逆向生成, 三阶段质量与多样性过滤
drawio_review_note: CORRECTED against arXiv:2508.09101v1 §§2.2.1 through 2.2.4, §4.1, and Table 8, plus official Tencent-Hunyuan/AutoCodeBenchmark@e611ddd60b3cb03a5961ccd41691863f4ed5e493 README and call_sandbox.py. The workflow distinguishes public demo_test_func cases (at most three, embedded in the problem as examples) from private full_test_func cases (seven or more, including edges, used as the comprehensive hidden correctness test). Both sets are generated and integrated, not selected as mutually exclusive branches. The pinned official evaluator runs full_test_func and demo_test_func and marks the record successful only when both executions return PASSED. The workflow also preserves reverse problem generation and the three filters, then records the post-hoc audit by 6 professional annotators across 6 languages that found 87.6% validity.
build_method_en: Stack-Edu seeds, LLM-sandbox reverse generation, three-stage quality and diversity filtering
intro_en: AutoCodeBench is a large-scale code generation benchmark containing 3,920 problems evenly distributed across 20 programming languages. It aims to evaluate large language models on challenging, diverse, and practical multilingual tasks. The benchmark is generated using an automated method called AutoCodeGen, which creates high-quality test cases through interactions between LLMs and multilingual sandboxes, requiring no manual annotation.
